"import cadquery as cq

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hard-coded dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
SEG1_D = 40.0   # diameter of segment 1
SEG1_Z0 = 0.0   # bottom z of segment 1
SEG1_Z1 = 30.0  # top z of segment 1

SEG2_D = 28.0   # diameter of segment 2
SEG2_Z0 = 30.0  # bottom z of segment 2
SEG2_Z1 = 55.0  # top z of segment 2

SEG3_D = 18.0   # diameter of segment 3
SEG3_Z0 = 55.0  # bottom z of segment 3
SEG3_Z1 = 75.0  # top z of segment 3

BORE_D = 8.0    # central through-bore diameter

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the three coaxial cylindrical segments (all on the Z axis)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
seg1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=SEG1_Z0)
    .circle(SEG1_D / 2.0)
    .extrude(SEG1_Z1 - SEG1_Z0)
)

seg2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=SEG2_Z0)
    .circle(SEG2_D / 2.0)
    .extrude(SEG2_Z1 - SEG2_Z0)
)

seg3 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=SEG3_Z0)
    .circle(SEG3_D / 2.0)
    .extrude(SEG3_Z1 - SEG3_Z0)
)

shaft = seg1.union(seg2).union(seg3)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Central through bore along Z, full length
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
bore = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .workplane(offset=SEG1_Z0)
    .circle(BORE_D / 2.0)
    .extrude(SEG3_Z1 - SEG1_Z0)
)

result = shaft.cut(bore)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity checks (single valid solid, positive volume)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
solid = result.val()
assert solid.isValid(), "Resulting shape is not a valid B-Rep solid"
assert solid.Volume() > 0.0, "Resulting solid has non-positive volume"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export the single solid as STEP
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cq.exporters.export(result, "part.step")"
